Name: Saeed Salehi
Bio:
Prof Saeed Salehi is a professor of mathematics and theoretical computer science. His academic work spans mathematical logic, computability, complexity, and philosophy of mathematics. He holds PhDs in theoretical computer science and mathematical logic, and has taught advanced courses while supervising doctoral and master's students.

Areas of work:

Mathematical logic

Computability and complexity theory

Theoretical computer science

Philosophy of mathematics
Education: PhD, University of Turku | PhD, Mathematical Logic, Polish Academy of Sciences | BSc, Pure Mathematics, Sharif University of Technology
Research_Interests: Mathematical Logic | Theory of Computability and Complexity Theory | Philosophy of Mathematics | Theoretical Computer Science
